name: Kelp
author: Erin Carter
description: A kelp forest deep underwater: wide cylinder-shaded ribbon blades rise in depth-layered ranks from an uneven seafloor, rounded and translucent with curling bent-over tips and float bulbs, through a blue-teal depth gradient lit by crepuscular god-rays, caustic shimmer and rising bubbles. When a surge front rolls across the stand the downstream edges light, a rim of glow climbing each blade from deep-blue roots to pale tips.

params.label: Surge rate
params.effect: How often surge fronts roll through the kelp forest.

params.label: Sway
params.effect: How far the blades lean downstream and overshoot on the elastic return.

params.label: Blade width
params.effect: CSS-pixel width of the kelp ribbons, from straps to broad fronds.

params.label: Rim glow
params.effect: Brightness of the edge light that climbs the blades while they bend.

params.label: Crowding
params.effect: How tightly the blades crowd the forest — low spreads them into open water, high packs them into a dense stand.

params.label: Variation
params.effect: Spread of per-blade root position, height, length and waviness — 0 lines them up as an even rank of identical blades, 1 gives the full natural scatter of a wild kelp stand.

params.label: Blade height
params.effect: Overall length of the blades from holdfast to tip — low leaves a low turf, high streams tall fronds toward the surface.

params.label: God-rays
params.effect: Strength of the crepuscular light shafts slanting down through the water — 0 is flat dim water, high pours bright sunbeams from the surface.

params.label: Caustics
params.effect: Intensity of the rippling caustic light shimmer playing over the upper water — 0 is still, high dapples the column with moving light.

params.label: Bubbles
params.effect: Amount and brightness of bubbles rising through the water — 0 clears them, high fills the column with a bright rising stream.

params.label: Bubble size
params.effect: Size of the rising bubbles, from fine sparkling motes to fat slow orbs.

params.label: Distortion
params.effect: A refractive wave that ripples the blades and bubbles horizontally as if seen through stirring water — 0 is clean and still.

params.label: Depth of field
params.effect: How strongly ranks away from the focal plane blur and haze — 0 keeps every layer crisp, high melts the far layers into a soft organic backdrop.

params.label: Focus
params.effect: Which depth plane stays sharp — 0 focuses the far back ranks, 1 the nearest blades; everything else softens with distance from it.
